presentationColumns.name: Store Code
presentationColumns.description: Stable business code for the physical store. Use this when you need an unambiguous store identifier that will not change if the display name changes.

presentationColumns.name: Store Name
presentationColumns.description: Unique business-facing store label. Names include city and neighborhood or street so OAC filters and AI Assistant prompts do not merge multiple physical stores.

presentationColumns.name: Region
presentationColumns.description: Commercial region or subnational geography used for store analysis, such as Greater London, Bavaria, Catalonia, or Lombardy.

presentationColumns.name: Store Format
presentationColumns.description: Retail format of the store, such as Flagship, High Street, Mall, or Outlet.

presentationColumns.name: Location Type
presentationColumns.description: Broad location classification such as Urban, Mall, or Outlet Village.

presentationColumns.name: Opening Date
presentationColumns.description: Date when the store opened. Use it for store maturity and lifecycle analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Selling Area SQM
presentationColumns.description: Approximate selling area in square meters. Use it to compare store scale and normalize traffic or inventory exposure.

presentationColumns.name: Climate Zone
presentationColumns.description: Climate classification for the store location, useful for seasonal assortment and weather-sensitive product analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Affluence Index
presentationColumns.description: Relative affluence indicator for the store catchment area. Use it as context for price tier, full-price demand, and assortment mix.

presentationColumns.name: Is Flagship
presentationColumns.description: Flags flagship stores. Use it to separate high-profile brand locations from standard stores.

presentationColumns.name: Is Outlet
presentationColumns.description: Flags outlet stores. Use it to separate clearance and outlet behavior from full-price retail stores.

presentationColumns.name: Latitude
presentationColumns.description: Store latitude for map visualizations and geographic analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Longitude
presentationColumns.description: Store longitude for map visualizations and geographic analysis.
